title: Gemma 2 text (2B): dense, alternating local and global attention at one rope base, sandwich norms, centered RMSNorm, NO q/k norm, attention-score soft cap 50 and final-logit cap 30; runs the Gemma 4 flow's dense arm
open_questions: correctness is recorded in docs/GGUF.md (llama.cpp cross-engine KL on the same bytes), not here: this profile holds no lab measurement yet
no lab performance measurement yet: the gate was a cross-engine correctness check, not a benchmark
the cap forces the barrier decode kernel and refuses TurboQuant KV; the GQA-shared kernel and a quantized-KV cap are unmeasured and unimplemented
traps: the attention-score cap exists only in attention_decode_partial: any other decode variant would silently skip it, which is why a nonzero cap forces the barrier kernel and refuses --kv-bits
no q/k norm tensors: the flow keys the skip on the family (families/gemma4/norm.rs applies_qk_norm), never on tensor presence
even layers slide and odd layers are global, the opposite phase to Gemma 3's 5:1 schedule, and both use the same rope base
